name: QQ Mail
description: Search, read, and organize messages through QQ Mail IMAP/SMTP, and create drafts or send mail. Cindy stores the authorization code securely and provides it to the plugin Worker only while handling a mail request.
whenToUse: Use when the user needs to find, read, or organize QQ Mail messages, create a draft, or send mail. Before first use, enter the QQ Mail address and IMAP/SMTP authorization code in the plugin details and complete the connection test.

qq_mail_status.description: Check whether QQ Mail is configured. Returns only the email address and connection status, never the authorization code.

qq_mail.description: QQ Mail via IMAP/SMTP. attachment_paths: user-authorized absolute local paths, up to 10 files (new ones ≤16 MiB each, 25 MiB total), never modified. read returns attachment names, sizes and SHA-256 without downloading; it rejects messages over 48 MiB (check search size). No top-level dir/attachments. Mutations need explicit user intent; check the mailbox before retrying an unknown outcome. search pages hold ≤20: continue with next_page_token as page_token and identical filters until has_more=false; claim full coverage only if coverage_complete=true throughout. since/before filter received_at (inclusive/exclusive; date-only is UTC+8). Server full-text search may miss mail; text_scope=metadata searches decoded headers only. Compose with draft/reply/reply_all/forward (reply_all is the default reply); drafts appear as editable Cindy cards. send_draft sends the card after a 10-second undo countdown, only after the user confirms. Direct send is not supported.

qq_mail_connect.description: Connect the given QQ Mail address using the IMAP/SMTP authorization code already saved securely by Cindy. Verify imap.qq.com and smtp.qq.com, then save the email address. Use after secure credential entry to complete or restore setup. Pass only the email address, never the authorization code. Does not send email.
